content.short: A Cannabis-based NFT project that brings art, culture, and technology together.
content.description:
Cardano Budz™ was conceived to not only be fun and collectable, but to also help raise awareness of the positive uses for medical and recreational Cannabis use. It is also to help promote safe access, and the Federal legalization and Decriminalization of Cannabis.

Our pool operates under the BUDZ ticker. 10% of the proceeds of all operator rewards goes to help these causes.

We are currently donating to these organizations:

Grow your own Adventure - We are building a Play-2-Earn game around the Cardano Budz NFTs and the BUDZ stake pool. Users will be able to grow virtual Cannabis plants and earn yield from them.
